agent_result: Done. Redis 6.0.16 installed globally via apt, running as a daemon (port 6379) with AOF persistence enabled (`appendonly yes`, plus default RDB save points). The Lua scripts were executed in order with `redis-cli --eval` (`01_init_users.lua` → `Users initialized`, then `02_init_flags.lua` → `Flags initialized`), setting `user:1=Alice`, `user:2=Bob`, `flags:enabled=true`, `flags:version=2.0` (updated to 3.0 in ACL test), `init_check=done`. ACL user `benchmark_user` / `benchmark_pass` was created with `~flags:* ~init_check` key access — verified it can read/write those keys and is denied on `user:1`. Data and the ACL user both persist across a restart (user defined in `/etc/redis/redis.conf`, data in `/var/lib/redis/appendonly.aof`).
